from pathlib import Path

from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib

R26='reports/research/510300_export_order_cause_increment_v1'
R21='reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1'
R23='reports/research/510300_saved_high_score_leaf_contribution_v1'
TOL=1e-12
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def save_new(name,obj):

def prepare(raw,features):
    ans={}
    for r in raw:
        m={'idx':int(r['idx']),'features':features,
          'left':np.asarray(r['tree_children_left'],int),'right':np.asarray(r['tree_children_right'],int),
          'feature':np.asarray(r['tree_feature'],int),'threshold':np.asarray(r['tree_threshold'],float),
          'value':np.asarray(r['tree_value'],float),'samples':np.asarray(r['tree_samples'],int),
          'n_train':int(r['n_train'])}
        leaf=m['left']<0
        m['leaf_values']=m['value'][leaf];m['leaf_weights']=m['samples'][leaf]
        assert int(m['leaf_weights'].sum())==m['n_train']==len(poolmap[m['idx']])
        assert (d.loc[poolmap[m['idx']],'exit_idx']<=m['idx']).all()
        ans[m['idx']]=m
    assert len(ans)==1212 and list(ans)==p.idx.astype(int).tolist()
    return ans
models={'外需十变量':prepare(readj(R26+'/保存外需十变量模型.json'),features10),
        '原纠错八变量':prepare(readj(R21+'/纠错8变量保存模型.json'),features8)}
def point(m,vector):
    x=np.asarray(vector,dtype=np.float32);assert np.isfinite(x).all()
    n=0;path=[]
    while m['left'][n]>=0:
        f=int(m['feature'][n]);path.append(m['features'][f])
        n=int(m['left'][n] if x[f]<=m['threshold'][n] else m['right'][n])
    v=float(m['value'][n]);weights=m['leaf_weights'];values=m['leaf_values']
    score=float(100*((weights[values<v].sum()/m['n_train'])+0.5*(weights[values==v].sum()/m['n_train'])))
    return v,score,n,path
def leaf_rows(m,indices,leaf):
    x=d.loc[indices,m['features']].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
    assert np.isfinite(x).all()
    nodes=np.zeros(len(indices),int)
    for _ in range(10):
        active=m['left'][nodes]>=0
        if not active.any():break
        rows=np.flatnonzero(active);old=nodes[rows];fs=m['feature'][old]
        nodes[rows]=np.where(x[rows,fs]<=m['threshold'][old],m['left'][old],m['right'][old])
    assert (m['left'][nodes]<0).all()
    return indices[nodes==leaf]
def high(v,s):return bool(s>=80 and v>0)
pairrows=[];pairmap={};max_checkpoint_error=0.
for name,mm in models.items():

    for pos,row in enumerate(p.itertuples(index=False)):
        i=int(row.idx);cur=mm[i];xn=d.loc[i,fs].to_numpy(float)
        D,sD,leafD,pathD=point(cur,xn)
        err=max(abs(D-float(getattr(row,predcol))),abs(sD-float(getattr(row,scorecol))))
        max_checkpoint_error=max(max_checkpoint_error,err);assert err<TOL,(name,i,'保存预测/分数不一致',err)
        if pos==0:continue
        before=p.iloc[pos-1];j=int(before.idx);prev=mm[j];xo=d.loc[j,fs].to_numpy(float)
        A,sA,leafA,_=point(prev,xo);B,sB,leafB,_=point(prev,xn);C,sC,leafC,_=point(cur,xo)
        assert abs(A-float(before[predcol]))<TOL and abs(sA-float(before[scorecol]))<TOL
        total=D-A;inp=B-A;mod=C-A;interaction=D-B-C+A
        assert abs(total-(inp+mod+interaction))<TOL
        sinp=sB-sA;smod=sC-sA;sinteraction=sD-sB-sC+sA
        assert abs((sD-sA)-(sinp+smod+sinteraction))<TOL
        export_changed=any(float(d.loc[i,c])!=float(d.loc[j,c]) for c in ['新出口订单水平','新出口订单月度变化'])
        newsource=pd.Timestamp(d.loc[i,'出口来源可知时间'])
        oldsource=pd.Timestamp(d.loc[j,'出口来源可知时间'])
        assert newsource<=pd.Timestamp(d.loc[i,'decision_time'])
        changelist=[f for f in fs if float(d.loc[i,f])!=float(d.loc[j,f])]
        source_date=newsource.tz_convert('Asia/Shanghai').normalize().tz_localize(None)
        rec={'model':name,'idx':i,'date':str(pd.Timestamp(row.date).date()),'era':row.era,
          'previous_idx':j,'previous_date':str(pd.Timestamp(before.date).date()),'session_gap':i-j,
          'consecutive_trade_sessions':i-j==1,
          'A_old_model_old_input':A,'B_old_model_current_input':B,
          'C_current_model_old_input':C,'D_current_model_current_input':D,
          'score_A':sA,'score_B':sB,'score_C':sC,'score_D':sD,
          'prediction_input_at_old_model':inp,'prediction_model_at_old_input':mod,
          'prediction_interaction':interaction,'prediction_total_change':total,
          'prediction_input_at_current_model':D-C,'prediction_model_at_current_input':D-B,
          'score_input_at_old_model':sinp,'score_model_at_old_input':smod,
          'score_interaction':sinteraction,'score_total_change':sD-sA,
          'export_document_changed':newsource!=oldsource,'export_values_changed':export_changed,
          'export_source_known_at':str(newsource),'export_stat_month':str(d.loc[i,'出口统计月']),
          'export_source_age_calendar_days':int((pd.Timestamp(d.loc[i,'date'])-source_date).days),
          'changed_input_features':'、'.join(changelist),'current_path_features':'、'.join(pathD),
          'current_leaf':leafD,'old_model_current_input_leaf':leafB,
          'high_A':high(A,sA),'high_B':high(B,sB),'high_C':high(C,sC),'high_D':high(D,sD),
          'new_high_transition':high(D,sD) and not high(A,sA),
          'old_input_current_model_alone_high':high(C,sC) and not high(A,sA),
          'current_input_old_model_alone_high':high(B,sB) and not high(A,sA),
          'high_requires_both_in_four_cells':high(D,sD) and not high(A,sA) and not high(B,sB) and not high(C,sC)}
        pairrows.append(rec);pairmap[(name,i)]=rec
pairs=pd.DataFrame(pairrows)

leafsummaries=[];members=[];months=[];flows=[];max_leaf_error=0.;reused_controls=0
for r in events.itertuples(index=False):
    name=r.model;i=int(r.idx);cur=models[name][i];fs=cur['features'];cpool=poolmap[i]

    y=d.loc[cidx,'net_label'].to_numpy(float);err=abs(float(y.mean())-D)
    max_leaf_error=max(max_leaf_error,err);assert err<TOL
    pi=pairmap.get((name,i));opool=set();bidx=np.array([],int);flow_total=None;newflow=None;rollflow=None;keepflow=None
    if pi:
        j=int(pi['previous_idx']);prev=models[name][j];opool=set(poolmap[j])
        _,_,leafB,_=point(prev,d.loc[i,fs].to_numpy(float))

        assert len(bidx)==int(prev['samples'][leafB])

        cset=set(cidx);bset=set(bidx);curpoolset=set(cpool)
        sums={'新成熟成员':0.,'滚出原窗口成员':0.,'保留成员分组或均值权重变化':0.}

            else:kind='保留成员分组或均值权重变化'

            flows.append({'model':name,'signal_idx':i,'signal_date':r.signal_date,'previous_decision_idx':j,
              'training_idx':k,'label_signal_date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.loc[k,'date']).date()),
              'label_exit_date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.loc[int(d.loc[k,'exit_idx']),'date']).date()),
              'mature_net5':value,'old_current_input_leaf_weight':oldcoef,'current_leaf_weight':newcoef,
              'signed_model_mean_change_contribution':delta,'membership_class':kind})
        flow_total=sum(sums.values());assert abs(flow_total-pi['prediction_model_at_current_input'])<TOL
        newflow=sums['新成熟成员'];rollflow=sums['滚出原窗口成员'];keepflow=sums['保留成员分组或均值权重变化']
    rows=[]
    for k,value in zip(cidx,y):
        item={'model':name,'signal_idx':i,'signal_date':r.signal_date,'era':r.era,'leaf':leafD,
          'training_idx':int(k),'label_signal_date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.loc[k,'date']).date()),
          'label_entry_date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.loc[int(k)+1,'date']).date()),
          'label_exit_date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.loc[int(k)+6,'date']).date()),
          'mature_net5':float(value),'label_signal_month':pd.Timestamp(d.loc[k,'date']).strftime('%Y-%m'),
          'newly_matured_since_previous_saved_decision':bool(pi is not None and int(k) not in opool)}
        members.append(item);rows.append(item)
    frame=pd.DataFrame(rows);positive_sum=float(np.maximum(y,0).sum())
    mrec=[]
    for month,block in frame.groupby('label_signal_month',sort=True):
        vals=block.mature_net5.to_numpy(float);ps=float(np.maximum(vals,0).sum())
        item={'model':name,'signal_idx':i,'signal_date':r.signal_date,'era':r.era,
          'label_signal_month':month,'members':len(block),'positive_label_sum':ps,
          'negative_label_sum':float(np.minimum(vals,0).sum()),'net_label_sum':float(vals.sum()),
          'leaf_mean_contribution':float(vals.sum()/len(frame)),
          'positive_label_contribution_fraction':ps/positive_sum if positive_sum>0 else None}
        months.append(item);mrec.append(item)
    assert abs(sum(x['leaf_mean_contribution'] for x in mrec)-D)<TOL
    top=max(mrec,key=lambda x:x['positive_label_sum'])
    topid=int(cidx[int(np.argmax(y))])
    item={'model':name,'signal_idx':i,'signal_date':r.signal_date,'era':r.era,

      'actual_net5':float(r.net_event_return),'leaf_median':float(np.median(y)),

      'largest_label_exit_date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.loc[topid+6,'date']).date()),
      'largest_label':float(d.loc[topid,'net_label']),
      'newly_matured_members_in_current_leaf':sum(x['newly_matured_since_previous_saved_decision'] for x in rows),
      'new_matured_mean_change_contribution':newflow,'rolled_out_mean_change_contribution':rollflow,
      'retained_group_weight_mean_change_contribution':keepflow,'model_mean_change_at_current_input':flow_total,
      'actual_path_features':'、'.join(path),

      'export_document_changed':pi['export_document_changed'] if pi else None,
      'export_values_changed':pi['export_values_changed'] if pi else None,
      'export_source_age_calendar_days':pi['export_source_age_calendar_days'] if pi else None,
      'current_model_old_input_prediction':pi['C_current_model_old_input'] if pi else None,

      'new_high_transition':pi['new_high_transition'] if pi else None,
      'old_input_current_model_alone_high':pi['old_input_current_model_alone_high'] if pi else None}
    leafsummaries.append(item)
